temporary-settings-description: You can temporarily override settings here for development purposes. Any changes will be stored locally in your browser only.
override-value-instructions: Click on the respective "Override value" entry to cycle through enabled, disabled and not set. If the feature flag is used on the server, reload the page via the reload button to apply them to the intial page load as well.
temporary-settings-warning: Because we cannot check the validity of a temporary settings value, this UI only allows you to intercept and reset a temporary setting. Due to the nature of the API only the current (overridden or actual) value is shown.
json-input-instructions: Enter a valid JSON below. Missing values are replaced with defaults.
